LESSON: HANDWASHING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Myself 1.2 External body parts -head, -hands -legs (12 lessons) By the end of th
Topic 1.3: Handwashing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Handwashing, part of Myself 1.2 External body parts -head, -hands -legs (12 lessons) By the end of th in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we wash hands?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Handwashing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: as learners use digital devices with assistive technology to watch and listen audio visual clips on handwashing

• Learning to learn: learner relates items used to wash hands to personal hygiene practices.

Values:
• Unity: learner enhances cooperation when sharing available items used in handwashing.

• Respect: learner nurtures respect when taking turns to wash hands

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Personal hygiene: learners wash hands appropriately before eating and after visiting the toilet.

Link to other learning area:

Handwashing activity relates with cleaning after carrying out leaf painting in Creative Activities

Suggested Learning Resources

Charts, picture cards, flash cards, braille cards, drawn pictures, glue, crayons, water, containers, soaps, hand towels, digital devices with assistive
